report:
Fresh final followup review of self_description. Saved/read prior report and inputs, started fresh and compared every initial fragment: claim, whole spec_plan.rs and TODO test are unchanged. Recaptured all nine prior dependencies. For shifted spec.rs ranges I located the previously intended contents and adjusted bounds, verifying exact equality; the validation-method range now 103-207 differs only by the implementation_references association comment. All other helper contents are unchanged. No validation, status or generation behavior changed.

The full claim requires book-system Design anchors to use the same naming/reference validation, independent implementation/test coverage, status reporting, index and page generation as other rules, with no validator/renderer exemptions and explicit TODO evidence for unfinished work. The sole associated implementation is the TODO region around todo::book_rules_use_the_same_validation, and the sole associated test is that empty TODO. It explicitly calls for ordinary coverage/rendering of the book's own rules and failures after deleting implementation/test links. It is not ordinary behavioral proof; no N/A evidence exists.

Current captured foundations support the intended uniformity without completing that integration claim. The normative predicate includes Design meta/book sources while excluding motivations/history/generated views. Shared namespace and reference loops operate over canonical anchors without book/validator/renderer prefix exemptions. Implementation and test coverage checks iterate anchors independently, and reverse-reference checks use the same map. Review inventory handles all anchors uniformly and preserves explicit TODO/N/A ancestry through the captured status helper. Generated index/page code consumes that same inventory, walks canonical names and computes separate implementation/test statuses. The new unknown-reference association comment only improves tracking and creates no exception.

The unchanged claim is itself a named Design anchor and its TODO evidence is discovered by the ordinary inventory, but this observation does not prove every self-hosting scenario. The assertion-free TODO remains an honest deferral. Completing it requires a real book-system fixture with validator/renderer claims, valid naming/references and explicit implementation/test links; independent deletion of each evidence side; malformed/dangling-reference mutations; and substantive index/page/status assertions, including TODO handling. Shared pipeline code is already a foundation for that work, not a substitute for the missing integrated assertions or a passing dummy-test proof.

All claim aspects were reassessed against the prior complete accounting and actual marker/range-shift delta. The substantive context remains unchanged, and the explicit deferral is preserved. No source edits, builds, rendering or behavioral test runs occurred; fresh start/read/record and source inspection only. No requested edits.
